firm_data.firm_description: ZEISLER PLLC litigates commercial and intellectual property disputes and counsels businesses, private funds and individuals in a sophisticated yet cost-effective manner. They are experienced lawyers with expertise in complex business and intellectual property matters.
notable_facts: The firm was founded in New York City in 2014.
The firm serves as outside “in-house” counsel to a number of their corporate and fund clients.

Aaron M. Zeisler and his colleagues secured the dismissal of trade secret misappropriation, breach of contract and unfair competition claims in an arbitration in New York brought by Bridgewater Associates against two former employees.

email.subject: AI for ZEISLER PLLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Aaron,

Since founding ZEISLER in 2014, you've built a sophisticated practice handling complex commercial and IP disputes for corporate and fund clients. That requires precision work with lean resources, and that's exactly what we've designed for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters for boutiques: client trust, cost-effectiveness, and competitive edge on complex litigation.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how we're helping similar practices compete without sacrificing quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
